caption_L1: Number of prisoners under jurisdiction of federal or state correctional authorities from 1990 to 2019 (in 1,000s) is a area plot. Along the x-axis, Year is measured. A linear scale of range 0 to 1,500 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Number of prisoners in thousands.
caption_L2L3: In 1990 around 750000 prisoners were in correctional facilities, there is an upward trend in numbers until around 2008 when numbers  reached approximately 1600000 and then began to fall. By 2019 numbers had fallen to around 1400000.
